tables.label: Table 4
tables.caption: Complete elimination (CE) concentrations of NCR247 and NCR335 on S. enterica and L. monocytogenes using drop plate method.
footnotes: NCR247 was active above 10 μM against S. enterica and above 50 μM against L. monocytogenes. NCR335 killed all the cells on the tested strains at 2.5 μM. Polymyxin B eliminated all S. enterica cells at a concentration less than 2.5 μM. L. monocytogenes was fully resistant to polymyxin B. Streptomycin had no effect on the tested bacteria. NE: no effect up to 50 μM.
